working_memory.text: A wildlife camera fixed to the old mill wall at Cobb weir has recorded a family of otters using the fish pass most nights since March. The footage shows two adults and three cubs, the first breeding confirmed on this stretch of river in living memory. The river trust that installed the camera credits cleaner water and the removal of a concrete sill two years ago. It has asked anglers to keep dogs on leads near the weir during the summer.
